line_check.method: Matched original nonempty source lines against #line coordinates, including inactive boundaries and comments. Existing mismatches listed explicitly.
line_check.qualification: The final edit also anchors the original selected precomp.h include at 12, with pragma hdrstop still at 13. Remaining matches are repeated conditional delimiters or FE_SB directives; explicit anchors 368 and 797 identify those original occurrences.

verification.scope: Current source diff, P8 source history, original and final masked metrics, exact logical stream. Prior product compile controls; no runtime rerun.

decision: Current source matched the S6 P8 product mirror before this review. R2354/2356/2360/2379: original service bodies need NT4 private USER receive ABI and queue, task and handle management. Current creation binding differs in argument count (17 vs 14). Removed six consecutive, immediately superseded #line directives (440,721,759,765,780,793); proved identical logical coordinates of every non-marker line. Original #error bodies unchanged. After the removal-only comparison, added #line 12 for the selected original PCH include. Net five fewer marker lines.
